definitions.explanation: A cylindrical device around which thread, yarn, or string is wound for storage or use. Also refers to the act of winding thread.
The peg on instruments like the shamisen, koto, or guitar used to adjust string tension and tuning.

examples.japanese: {糸巻|いとま}きに{糸|いと}を{巻|ま}いた。
examples.english: I wound thread onto the spool.

examples.japanese: {裁縫|さいほう}{箱|ばこ}の{中|なか}に{糸巻|いとま}きがたくさん{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: There are many spools inside the sewing box.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{色|いろ}とりどりの{糸|いと}を{糸巻|いとま}きに{丁寧|ていねい}に{巻|ま}き{直|なお}していた。
examples.english: My grandmother was carefully rewinding colorful threads onto spools.

examples.japanese: {三味線|しゃみせん}の{糸巻|いとま}きを{回|まわ}す。
examples.english: To turn the tuning peg of a shamisen.

examples.japanese: {糸巻|いとま}きが{緩|ゆる}んで{音|おと}が{狂|くる}った。
examples.english: The tuning peg loosened and the sound went out of tune.

examples.japanese: {演奏|えんそう}の{前|まえ}に{糸巻|いとま}きを{調整|ちょうせい}して{音|おと}を{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: Before the performance, I adjust the tuning pegs to tune the instrument.

notes:
Composed of {糸|いと} (thread) + {巻|ま}き (winding). The word has two distinct uses: the sewing/craft meaning (spool or bobbin) and the musical instrument meaning (tuning peg). The musical sense is primarily associated with traditional Japanese instruments like the {三味線|しゃみせん} and {琴|こと}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糸巻|いとま}きに{巻|ま}く: to wind onto a spool
- {糸巻|いとま}きを{回|まわ}す: to turn the spool/tuning peg
- {木製|もくせい}の{糸巻|いとま}き: wooden spool

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ボビン: bobbin — the sewing-machine-specific spool; from English
- リール: reel — for fishing line or film; from English
- ペグ: peg — the Western musical instrument tuning peg; from English
